_note: woo-request-from-a-portal-dossier (hydra woo-citizen-journey C5), design D1 and D3. Seeds the Woo request case type the template library only offered: eight statuses, four result types (woo-case-type requires them), the intake properties and portal windows open in its first two statuses. The fixed uuid is what WooRequestIntake opens a resident's request on. case.wooRequest carries the request itself: what was asked, for which period, where it came from and the dossier it was started from, which the publish side reads to bring the decision back.
